words.enDefinition: a plan showing the places and times on a trip

examples.en: I sent our itinerary to my flatmates before we left campus on Saturday morning.
examples.zh: 周六早上离开学校前，我把「行程安排」发给了室友。

examples.en: The itinerary listed two places to visit before lunch and one afterwards.
examples.zh: 「行程安排」列出了午饭前去的两个地方和午饭后去的一个地方。

words.enDefinition: a trip away and back on the same day

examples.en: We took a day trip to a nearby town after our exams finished.
examples.zh: 考完试后，我们去附近的小镇「当天往返玩了一趟」。

examples.en: A day trip worked well because nobody wanted to spend money on a room.
examples.zh: 大家都不想花钱住一晚，所以「当天往返的短途旅行」很合适。

words.enDefinition: a short trip for a change of scene over a weekend

examples.en: We planned a weekend getaway after handing in the last assignment of the term.
examples.zh: 交完这学期最后一份作业后，我们计划来趟「周末短途度假」。

examples.en: The coast sounded ideal for a weekend getaway before the exam period began.
examples.zh: 考试周开始前，去海边「周末短途度假」听起来挺合适。

words.enDefinition: an outing that takes only part of the day

examples.en: We chose a half-day trip so we could get back before evening rehearsal.
examples.zh: 我们选了「半日游」，好在晚上的排练开始前回来。

examples.en: A half-day trip gave us enough time to see the old market and gardens.
examples.zh: 一次「半日游」让我们有足够的时间逛旧市场和花园。

collocations: a half-day trip to a town

words.enDefinition: a journey that you make on your own

examples.en: On my first solo trip, I spent as long as I wanted at each stop.
examples.zh: 第一次「独自旅行」时，我每到一处想待多久就待多久。

examples.en: I chose a solo trip because my friends had different reading weeks this year.
examples.zh: 我的朋友今年阅读周的时间不一样，所以我选了「独自旅行」。

words.enDefinition: a short leisure trip taken together by several people

examples.en: Our residence planned a group outing to the gardens after everyone finished unpacking.
examples.zh: 等大家都收拾完行李后，宿舍组织了一次去花园的「集体出游」。

examples.en: I joined the group outing to meet people from other courses before term started.
examples.zh: 我参加了「集体出游」，想在开学前认识其他专业的同学。

words.enDefinition: a short organized trip away from a usual place

examples.en: The college arranged an excursion to the coast for students staying over the break.
examples.zh: 学院给假期留校的学生安排了一次去海边的「短途出游」。

examples.en: Our excursion included a stop at a small gallery on the way back.
examples.zh: 我们的「短途出游」安排了回程在一家小画廊停留。

words.enDefinition: a trip that includes a night away from home

examples.en: We turned the visit into an overnight trip so we could see the town after dark.
examples.zh: 为了看看天黑后的小镇，我们把这趟参观改成了「在外过夜的旅行」。

examples.en: I took just one bag for the overnight trip with my project group.
examples.zh: 我和项目组一起「在外过夜旅行」，只带了一个包。

words.enDefinition: the person arranging the details of a group's trip

examples.en: I asked the trip organizer what time we needed to be outside the museum.
examples.zh: 我问「出游组织者」，我们得几点到博物馆外面。

examples.en: The trip organizer kept a list of everyone who was joining us on Saturday.
examples.zh: 「出游组织者」记录了所有周六和我们一起出游的人的名字。

words.enDefinition: a route past several sights returning to its starting place

examples.en: We planned a sightseeing loop through the old town ending at our starting point.
examples.zh: 我们规划了穿过老城的「环形游览路线」，最后回到出发点。

examples.en: The map suggested a sightseeing loop with two short stops along the river.
examples.zh: 地图推荐了一条「环形游览路线」，沿河有两个短暂停留的地方。

words.enDefinition: a trip plan with many activities and little spare time

examples.en: We had a packed itinerary on Saturday, so we kept Sunday free for resting.
examples.zh: 周六「行程排得很满」，所以我们留出周日休息。

examples.en: With a packed itinerary, we only spent a few minutes in each room.
examples.zh: 由于「行程排得很满」，我们在每个房间只停了几分钟。

collocations: a packed itinerary for one day

words.enDefinition: leave room to change the plans during a trip

examples.en: We decided to keep the itinerary flexible because the weather could change by lunchtime.
examples.zh: 天气可能到午饭时就变了，所以我们决定「给行程留出调整余地」。

examples.en: I wanted to keep the itinerary flexible in case some friends arrived quite late.
examples.zh: 有些朋友可能到得挺晚，我想「给行程留出调整余地」。

collocations: try to keep the itinerary flexible
decide to keep the itinerary flexible
keep the itinerary flexible for the group

words.enDefinition: stay mainly in a place while visiting other locations nearby

examples.en: You could base yourself in the old town and visit nearby villages during the day.
examples.zh: 你可以「以老城为出游据点」，白天去附近的村庄转转。

examples.en: It makes sense to base yourself in one place if you have only three days.
examples.zh: 如果只有三天，「以一个地方为出游据点」比较方便。

collocations: choose where to base yourself in the region

words.enDefinition: a short visit added to the main journey

examples.en: We took a side trip to the old pier on our way to the gardens.
examples.zh: 去花园的路上，我们「顺道去了一趟」旧码头。

examples.en: My friend suggested a side trip when we saw signs for the sculpture park.
examples.zh: 看到通往雕塑公园的指示牌时，朋友建议「顺道去一趟」。

words.zhGloss: 离某地很近且方便到达
words.enDefinition: close enough to get to without much effort
acceptedZhAnswers: 离某地很近且方便到达

examples.en: The garden is within easy reach of the town centre, so we went after lunch.
examples.zh: 这个花园「离市中心很近，过去也方便」，所以我们午饭后去了。

examples.en: We chose somewhere within easy reach of the museum for our afternoon break.
examples.zh: 我们选了个「离博物馆近又好到的地方」，下午去休息一下。

collocations: within easy reach of the town centre
within easy reach of several sights

words.enDefinition: the period of time available for making a trip

examples.en: Our travel window was only three days between the end of exams and work.
examples.zh: 从考完试到上班之间，我们「可出游的时间段」只有三天。

examples.en: I chose a shorter visit because it fit within the travel window we had.
examples.zh: 我选了时间更短的游览，因为能安排在现有的「可出游时间段」内。

words.expression: set aside a day for sightseeing
words.lemma: set aside a day for sightseeing
words.enDefinition: reserve an entire day to visit places of interest
acceptedEnVariants: set aside a day for sightseeing

examples.en: We agreed to set aside a day for sightseeing before our group workshop began.
examples.zh: 我们约好在小组工作坊开始前，「留出一天观光」。

examples.en: I decided to set aside a day for sightseeing after visiting my old roommate.
examples.zh: 拜访以前的室友后，我决定「留出一天观光」。

collocations: plan to set aside a day for sightseeing
decide to set aside a day for sightseeing
try to set aside a day for sightseeing

words.enDefinition: a slow, relaxed rate of movement or activity

examples.en: We walked at a leisurely pace so everyone could look at the old shopfronts.
examples.zh: 我们「不紧不慢地」走着，让大家都能看看旧店面。

examples.en: The guide kept a leisurely pace while our group moved past the garden walls.
examples.zh: 我们小组沿着花园围墙经过时，导游走得「不紧不慢」。

words.enDefinition: extra time included to allow for possible delays

examples.en: We left buffer time between the two visits in case the first tour ran late.
examples.zh: 我们在两次参观之间「预留了机动时间」，以防第一场导览拖延。

examples.en: The buffer time gave us a chance to sit down after leaving the tower.
examples.zh: 从塔里出来后，「预留的机动时间」让我们有机会坐下来歇一会儿。

words.enDefinition: at the speed that suits you personally

examples.en: You can look around at your own pace once you've picked up the visitor map.
examples.zh: 拿到游客地图后，你可以「按自己的节奏」随便看看。

examples.en: The leaflet says you can explore at your own pace once the guided introduction finishes.
examples.zh: 宣传单上说，导游介绍完后，你可以「按自己的节奏」逛。

collocations: look around at your own pace

words.enDefinition: arrive before a place gets busy with visitors

examples.en: We got there just after opening to beat the crowds at the old market.
examples.zh: 我们刚开门就到旧市场了，想「赶在人多之前到」。

examples.en: I wanted to beat the crowds because we only had an hour in town.
examples.zh: 我们在镇上只有一小时，我想「赶在人多之前到」。

collocations: arrive early to beat the crowds
beat the crowds at a popular site

words.enDefinition: an alternative activity suitable when the weather is wet

examples.en: We kept the gallery as a rainy-day option in case the garden paths were soaked.
examples.zh: 我们把画廊留作「下雨天的备选安排」，以防花园小路积水。

examples.en: The rainy-day option was a short visit to the town's covered market after lunch.
examples.zh: 「下雨天的备选安排」是午饭后去镇上的室内市场逛一会儿。

collocations: keep a rainy-day option in mind

words.enDefinition: the period when a destination receives fewer visitors

examples.en: I visited in the low season and had time to look around without queues.
examples.zh: 我在「旅游淡季」去的，不用排队，能慢慢逛。

examples.en: Some tours ran less often during the low season, so we checked the schedule.
examples.zh: 「旅游淡季」有些导览的场次比较少，所以我们查了时刻安排。

words.zhGloss: 旅游淡旺季之间的时段
words.enDefinition: the period between the busiest and quietest travel seasons
acceptedZhAnswers: 旅游淡旺季之间的时段

examples.en: We went in the shoulder season, when the town was lively and queues were short.
examples.zh: 我们在「旅游淡旺季之间的时段」去的，镇上挺热闹，队却不长。

examples.en: A shoulder season visit worked for us because our break started earlier that year.
examples.zh: 那年我们的假期开始得早，所以可以在「旅游淡旺季之间的时段」去。

words.enDefinition: a trip arranged very shortly before leaving

examples.en: We took a last-minute trip after our tutor moved the Friday seminar online.
examples.zh: 导师把周五的研讨课改到线上后，我们来了次「临时决定的旅行」。

examples.en: My roommate suggested a last-minute trip when we discovered we both had Monday free.
examples.zh: 发现我们俩周一都有空，室友就建议来一次「临时决定的旅行」。

collocations: a last-minute trip during the break

words.enDefinition: following the same route on the way there and back

examples.en: We chose an out-and-back walk along the river so we could turn around whenever needed.
examples.zh: 我们选了沿河「原路往返的」散步路线，想什么时候折返都行。

examples.en: The out-and-back route gave us another chance to see the old houses in afternoon light.
examples.zh: 这条「原路往返的」路线让我们回程还能看看午后阳光里的老房子。

words.enDefinition: a particularly good place that few people know about

examples.en: The small garden felt like a hidden gem because we practically had it to ourselves.
examples.zh: 小花园几乎只有我们在逛，像是个「少有人知的好地方」。

examples.en: My host described the gallery as a hidden gem at the end of the alley.
examples.zh: 接待我的人说，巷子尽头的画廊是个「少有人知的好地方」。

collocations: describe a place as a hidden gem
a hidden gem near the centre

words.enDefinition: at a place commonly visited by tourists following familiar routes

examples.en: The old bridge is on the tourist trail, so it gets busy before noon.
examples.zh: 这座旧桥「在热门游客路线上」，中午前就挺热闹。

examples.en: We stayed on the tourist trail that morning because we wanted to see the main sights.
examples.zh: 上午我们沿着「热门游客路线」走，因为想看看主要景点。

collocations: a town on the tourist trail
a stop on the tourist trail
well known on the tourist trail

words.enDefinition: a short leisure trip spent visiting a city

examples.en: We took a city break during our reading week and visited two museums each day.
examples.zh: 阅读周我们去了一趟「城市短假游」，每天参观两家博物馆。

examples.en: My flatmate wanted a city break with plenty of time for cafés and galleries.
examples.zh: 室友想来趟「城市短假游」，留足时间去咖啡馆和画廊。

words.enDefinition: a trip organized and led by students

examples.en: I joined a student-led trip to the coast during my first month at university.
examples.zh: 上大学的第一个月，我参加了「学生自行组织的出游」，去了海边。

examples.en: The student-led trip included two visits that our society had arranged in advance.
examples.zh: 这次「学生自行组织的出游」有两场参观，都是社团提前安排的。

collocations: a student-led trip to a town

words.enDefinition: a place you stop at without arranging it beforehand

examples.en: We made an unplanned stop when we saw the sign for the riverside garden.
examples.zh: 看到通往河边花园的牌子时，我们「临时加了一站」。

examples.en: The itinerary left room for an unplanned stop if we found somewhere interesting.
examples.zh: 行程留了余地，遇到有意思的地方可以「临时加一站」。

words.enDefinition: visit the most notable places or parts of a destination

examples.en: We had two hours in town, so we decided to hit the highlights first.
examples.zh: 我们在镇上有两小时，所以决定先「逛一逛主要景点」。

examples.en: The morning walk let us hit the highlights before meeting the others for lunch.
examples.zh: 上午散步时，我们先「逛了一下主要景点」，再去和其他人一起吃午饭。

collocations: hit the highlights in an afternoon
a tour that will hit the highlights

words.enDefinition: visiting interesting or well-known places as a traveler

examples.en: We spent the afternoon sightseeing after our workshop ended earlier than we had expected.
examples.zh: 工作坊比预想的早结束，我们下午就去「观光」了。

examples.en: I saved Saturday for sightseeing because I wanted to explore the city on foot.
examples.zh: 我把周六留给「观光」，想步行逛一逛这座城市。

words.enDefinition: a place or feature that people travel to visit

examples.en: The old mill became a tourist attraction after local volunteers opened it to visitors.
examples.zh: 本地志愿者把旧磨坊向公众开放后，它成了一个「旅游景点」。

examples.en: We picked one tourist attraction nearby because we only had the afternoon free.
examples.zh: 我们只有下午有空，就挑了附近的一个「旅游景点」。

words.enDefinition: a location connected with an important part of the past

examples.en: I visited a historic site near the coast after reading about it in class.
examples.zh: 我在课上读到过海边的一处「历史遗址」，后来去看了看。

examples.en: The historic site had a small outdoor display explaining how people once lived there.
examples.zh: 这处「历史遗址」有个小型室外展区，介绍过去人们在那里怎样生活。

words.enDefinition: a route linking places of local historical or cultural interest

examples.en: We followed a heritage trail past the old school and several former workshop buildings.
examples.zh: 我们沿一条「历史文化游览线路」走，经过旧学校和几座原来的工坊。

examples.en: The heritage trail started near the market, where we picked up a free leaflet.
examples.zh: 「历史文化游览线路」从市场附近开始，我们在那里拿了份免费宣传单。

collocations: a leaflet for a heritage trail

words.enDefinition: a platform high above the ground for looking at the view

examples.en: We went up to the observation deck to see the city just before sunset.
examples.zh: 我们赶在日落前登上「高处观景台」看城市风景。

examples.en: The observation deck was quieter in the morning, and we stayed there for several minutes.
examples.zh: 早上「高处观景台」人少些，我们在那里停留了几分钟。

collocations: go up to the observation deck
the view from an observation deck

words.enDefinition: a place where you can enjoy an especially attractive view

examples.en: We paused at a scenic viewpoint overlooking the river before walking back into town.
examples.zh: 走回镇上之前，我们在一个俯瞰河流的「观景点」停了一会儿。

examples.en: The map showed a scenic viewpoint at the end of the gardens' main path.
examples.zh: 地图上显示，花园主路尽头有一个「观景点」。

words.enDefinition: a wide view covering much of the surrounding area

examples.en: The hill gave us a panoramic view of the harbour and the surrounding streets.
examples.zh: 在山丘上，我们看到了港口和周边街道「开阔的全景」。

examples.en: I stayed longer for the panoramic view once the clouds began to move away.
examples.zh: 云开始散开后，我留下来多看了一会儿这片「开阔的全景」。

collocations: a panoramic view of the city

words.enDefinition: a brief pause during a trip to take pictures

examples.en: We made a photo stop by the old bridge while the light was still good.
examples.zh: 趁光线还好，我们在旧桥旁「停留拍了会儿照」。

examples.en: The guide allowed a photo stop before our group entered the garden through the side gate.
examples.zh: 从侧门进花园之前，导游「留了一段时间给我们拍照」。

words.enDefinition: a center providing information and services at or near an attraction

examples.en: The visitor center gave us a leaflet about the old buildings along the river.
examples.zh: 「游客中心」给了我们一张介绍河边老建筑的宣传单。

examples.en: I waited outside the visitor center until the rest of my project group arrived.
examples.zh: 我在「游客中心」外面等项目组其他人到齐。

collocations: a map from the visitor center

words.enDefinition: an office offering destination information for travelers across an area

examples.en: The tourist information office suggested an indoor visit because the gardens were closed that afternoon.
examples.zh: 花园当天下午闭园，「旅游咨询处」推荐了一个室内景点。

examples.en: I got a town map from the tourist information office before finding my friends.
examples.zh: 去找朋友之前，我在「旅游咨询处」拿了一张小镇地图。

collocations: ask at the tourist information office

words.enDefinition: a map showing places and facilities at a visitor attraction

examples.en: The visitor map showed which rooms were open and where the garden path began.
examples.zh: 「游客游览图」标出了开放的房间以及花园小路的起点。

examples.en: I kept the visitor map in my pocket so I could check the route later.
examples.zh: 我把「游客游览图」放进口袋，方便之后查看路线。

words.enDefinition: amenities such as toilets or rest areas provided for visitors

examples.en: The leaflet marked visitor facilities near the entrance, including toilets and a covered seating area.
examples.zh: 宣传单标出了入口附近的「游客服务设施」，包括洗手间和有顶的座位区。

examples.en: We checked the visitor facilities before deciding where to take our afternoon break.
examples.zh: 决定下午在哪儿歇一会儿之前，我们查了查「游客服务设施」。

words.enDefinition: the entrance set aside for people coming to visit

examples.en: The visitor entrance is around the corner from the main offices of the historic house.
examples.zh: 「游客入口」就在那座老宅的主办公室拐个弯的地方。

examples.en: I waited at the visitor entrance until my friend came back with the tickets.
examples.zh: 我在「游客入口」等朋友拿着票回来。

words.enDefinition: the price charged for entering a site or attraction

examples.en: I checked the admission fee before adding the museum to our weekend plans.
examples.zh: 把博物馆加进周末计划之前，我查了「门票费用」。

examples.en: The leaflet listed the admission fee beside a map showing the visitor entrance.
examples.zh: 宣传单在标有游客入口的地图旁边列了「门票费用」。

words.enDefinition: entry to a place without an admission charge

examples.en: The gallery offered free admission on the morning we went after our seminar.
examples.zh: 研讨课结束后，我们上午去的那家画廊提供「免费入场」。

examples.en: I chose the garden because free admission made it an easy stop for our group.
examples.zh: 我选了花园，因为「免费入场」，我们一组人顺路去也方便。

words.enDefinition: an amount a place invites visitors to give voluntarily

examples.en: The desk had a sign with a suggested donation beside the entrance to the garden.
examples.zh: 花园入口旁的服务台有块牌子，写着「建议捐款金额」。

examples.en: I noticed the suggested donation while picking up a visitor map at the desk.
examples.zh: 在服务台拿游客游览图时，我注意到了「建议捐款金额」。

collocations: a suggested donation at the entrance

words.enDefinition: a price offered to students who qualify for it

examples.en: I asked whether the student rate applied to the special tour as well.
examples.zh: 我问那场特别导览是否也有「学生票价」。

examples.en: The website showed a student rate when we checked admission for the exhibition.
examples.zh: 我们查询展览门票时，网站显示了「学生票价」。

words.zhGloss: 面向特定人群的优惠票
words.enDefinition: a reduced-price ticket for eligible groups of visitors
acceptedZhAnswers: 面向特定人群的优惠票

examples.en: At the UK gallery, I asked who could buy a concession ticket for the exhibition.
examples.zh: 在英国这家画廊，我问了展览「面向特定人群的优惠票」谁可以买。

examples.en: She checked whether she could use a concession ticket before booking a morning visit.
examples.zh: 订上午的参观前，她查了自己是否可以用「面向特定人群的优惠票」。

words.enDefinition: a system assigning visitors particular times to enter

examples.en: The exhibition uses timed entry, so we booked a visit just before lunch.
examples.zh: 展览采用「分时段入场」，所以我们订在午饭前去看。

examples.en: I checked whether the garden required timed entry when our group changed its plans.
examples.zh: 我们小组改计划时，我查了花园是否要求「分时段入场」。

words.enDefinition: a specific time or period reserved for someone to enter

examples.en: We booked an entry slot in the morning so we could see the gardens later.
examples.zh: 我们订了上午的「入场时段」，之后还能去看花园。

examples.en: I checked my entry slot before deciding how long to stay in the market.
examples.zh: 我先查了「入场时段」，再决定在市场待多久。

words.enDefinition: a ticket that allows entry without fixing one exact time

examples.en: I bought a flexible entry ticket because my project meeting might finish quite late.
examples.zh: 我的项目会可能结束得挺晚，所以买了「入场时间灵活的门票」。

examples.en: Our flexible entry ticket let us visit in the afternoon after the garden tour.
examples.zh: 我们的「入场时间灵活的门票」能让我们在花园导览结束后下午再去参观。

words.enDefinition: tickets available at the venue to people without advance reservations

examples.en: We asked about walk-up tickets because we hadn't decided to visit until that morning.
examples.zh: 我们那天上午才决定去，就问了有没有「到场现买的门票」。

examples.en: A small sign at the entrance said walk-up tickets were available that afternoon.
examples.zh: 入口处一块小牌子写着，当天下午有「到场现买的门票」。

words.enDefinition: a ticket intended to shorten waiting in the regular entry queue

examples.en: The gallery employee showed us where to use our skip-the-line ticket at the entrance.
examples.zh: 画廊工作人员在入口处告诉了我们在哪里用「免排普通队的门票」。

examples.en: I checked whether the skip-the-line ticket applied to both buildings at the site.
examples.zh: 我查了「免排普通队的门票」是否对景点的两栋楼都适用。

collocations: the lane for a skip-the-line ticket

words.enDefinition: one ticket covering a fixed set of specific sites or attractions

examples.en: We bought a combination ticket for the garden and the house before walking to either.
examples.zh: 去花园或老宅前，我们买了两处通用的「景点联票」。

examples.en: The combination ticket included both rooms, so we visited the upper floor first.
examples.zh: 「景点联票」涵盖两个房间，所以我们先参观了楼上的。

collocations: a combination ticket for two sites

words.enDefinition: a pass giving entry to a selection of attractions across a destination

examples.en: I considered a multi-attraction pass because we planned to visit several places across town.
examples.zh: 我们计划逛遍镇上好几个地方，我就考虑买「多景点通票」。

examples.en: The multi-attraction pass included a list of sites we could visit over the weekend.
examples.zh: 「多景点通票」附了一张清单，列出了周末可以去的景点。

words.enDefinition: a ticket that allows you to enter a place once

examples.en: I bought a single-entry ticket because we planned to see everything in one visit.
examples.zh: 我们计划一次看完，就买了「单次入场票」。

examples.en: The single-entry ticket suited our group because nobody wanted to leave halfway through.
examples.zh: 「单次入场票」挺适合我们这一组，因为没人想中途离开。

words.enDefinition: a notice saying visitors can return after leaving the venue

examples.en: The ticket said 'Re-entry allowed,' so we went outside for lunch between the two visits.
examples.zh: 票上写着「允许再次入场」，所以看完一部分后我们出去吃了午饭。

examples.en: I saw 'Re-entry allowed' on the sign and left to meet my friend briefly.
examples.zh: 我看见牌子写着「允许再次入场」，就出去和朋友碰了个面。

collocations: confirm re-entry allowed at the desk

words.enDefinition: a notice saying an extra ticket is needed for something

examples.en: The exhibition page said 'Separate ticket required' for the rooms on the upper floor.
examples.zh: 展览页面写着，上楼参观那些房间「需另购门票」。

examples.en: I noticed 'Separate ticket required' beside the tower on the visitor map at the entrance.
examples.zh: 我在入口的游客游览图上看到，塔旁边标了「需另购门票」。

collocations: a sign saying separate ticket required
an exhibit marked separate ticket required
see separate ticket required on the map

words.enDefinition: no more admission tickets remain for that day

examples.en: The museum was sold out for the day, so we visited the gardens instead.
examples.zh: 博物馆「当天门票已经售罄」，我们就改去花园。

examples.en: The tower was sold out for the day by the time we reached the ticket desk.
examples.zh: 我们到售票台时，塔楼「当天门票已经售罄」。

collocations: already sold out for the day
tickets are sold out for the day
the tour is sold out for the day

words.zhGloss: 可同时接待的游客上限
words.enDefinition: the maximum number of visitors a place can accommodate at once
acceptedZhAnswers: 可同时接待的游客上限

examples.en: The room reached visitor capacity, and the staff asked us to wait in the courtyard.
examples.zh: 房间到了「可同时接待的游客上限」，工作人员请我们在院子里等。

examples.en: The guide mentioned visitor capacity before taking our small group into the upstairs room.
examples.zh: 带我们小组上楼进房间前，导游提到了「可同时接待的游客上限」。

words.enDefinition: unavailable for entry by people coming to visit

examples.en: The courtyard was closed to visitors while staff prepared for an event that evening.
examples.zh: 工作人员在准备晚间活动，院子「不对游客开放」。

examples.en: We followed a different path because the old reading room was closed to visitors.
examples.zh: 老阅览室「不对游客开放」，我们就走了另一条路线。

words.enDefinition: likely to change according to the weather conditions

examples.en: The garden tour is weather-dependent, so we checked our messages before leaving campus.
examples.zh: 花园导览是「视天气而定的」，所以我们离校前看了一眼消息。

examples.en: Our booking described the tower visit as weather-dependent because part of it is outside.
examples.zh: 预订里说，塔楼参观是「视天气而定的」，因为有一部分在室外。

words.enDefinition: a tour in which visitors move between places on foot

examples.en: We joined a walking tour to see the streets we had missed the day before.
examples.zh: 我们参加了「步行游览」，去看看前一天漏逛的街道。

examples.en: The walking tour ended near the market, where we planned to have lunch afterwards.
examples.zh: 「步行游览」在市场附近结束，我们计划之后去那里吃午饭。

collocations: a walking tour of the old town

words.enDefinition: a recording or device giving spoken information about a place

examples.en: I used an audio guide because I wanted more time in the smaller rooms.
examples.zh: 我用了「语音导览」，因为想在较小的房间里多待一会儿。

examples.en: The audio guide explained why the windows were different on each side of the house.
examples.zh: 「语音导览」解释了为什么老宅两侧的窗户不一样。

words.enDefinition: an organized tour offered to a limited number of people

examples.en: We booked a small-group tour because everyone wanted to ask questions about the old buildings.
examples.zh: 我们订了「小团导览」，因为大家都有关于老建筑的问题想问。

examples.en: The small-group tour still had space when I checked after my morning lecture.
examples.zh: 我上午下课后查看时，「小团导览」还有空位。

collocations: a small-group tour with a guide

words.enDefinition: a tour provided exclusively for one visitor or group

examples.en: Our society arranged a private tour so members could focus on the workshop buildings.
examples.zh: 我们社团安排了「专为一组安排的导览」，让成员能重点看那些工坊建筑。

examples.en: I asked about a private tour before deciding to join the larger group instead.
examples.zh: 我先问了「专为一组安排的导览」，后来决定参加人数更多的团。

collocations: a private tour for our group

words.enDefinition: a business that organizes and runs tours for travelers

examples.en: I contacted the tour operator when the booking page showed two different start times.
examples.zh: 预订页面显示了两个不同的开始时间，我就联系了「旅游团承办方」。

examples.en: The tour operator emailed our group before moving the meeting point to the courtyard.
examples.zh: 「旅游团承办方」给我们小组发了邮件，随后把集合点挪到了院子里。

words.enDefinition: spoken explanations given live while visitors travel or look around

examples.en: The guide provided live commentary as we passed the workshops along the old canal.
examples.zh: 我们经过旧运河边的工坊时，导游做了「现场讲解」。

examples.en: I could hear the live commentary clearly when our group stopped by the bridge.
examples.zh: 我们小组在桥边停下时，我能听清楚「现场讲解」。

words.enDefinition: headphones receiving the guide's voice during a group tour

examples.en: I put on the tour headset so I could hear the guide across the courtyard.
examples.zh: 为了隔着院子也能听到导游，我戴上了「导览接收耳机」。

examples.en: We returned each tour headset before leaving the last room of the house.
examples.zh: 离开老宅最后一个房间之前，我们归还了各自的「导览接收耳机」。

words.enDefinition: the place where people have agreed to gather

examples.en: The guide asked us to be at the meeting point beside the market steps.
examples.zh: 导游请我们到市场台阶旁那个「约定的集合点」去。

examples.en: I took a photo of the meeting point so I could find it again later.
examples.zh: 我给「约定的集合点」拍了张照，方便之后再找到那里。

words.enDefinition: the time when a tour group is scheduled to set off

examples.en: We checked the tour departure time before deciding whether to stop for a coffee.
examples.zh: 决定要不要停下来喝杯咖啡前，我们先查了「导览团出发时间」。

examples.en: The note on my ticket showed a tour departure time just before lunchtime.
examples.zh: 我票上的备注显示，「导览团出发时间」在午饭前不久。

words.enDefinition: tell the guide that you have arrived for the tour

examples.en: Please check in with the guide by the steps before we set off together.
examples.zh: 一起出发前，「请在台阶旁向导游报到」。

examples.en: I went to check in with the guide before looking for somewhere to sit.
examples.zh: 我先去「向导游报到」，再找地方坐。

collocations: please check in with the guide
remember to check in with the guide
check in with the guide at the entrance

words.enDefinition: the length of time a tour takes from start to finish

examples.en: I checked the tour duration because we were meeting friends for dinner afterwards.
examples.zh: 我们约了之后和朋友吃晚饭，所以我查了「导览时长」。

examples.en: The leaflet listed the tour duration just under the picture of the old house.
examples.zh: 宣传单把「导览时长」列在老宅照片正下方。

words.enDefinition: the places visited along the route of a tour

examples.en: We looked at the tour stops and chose the route with the old bridge.
examples.zh: 我们看了「导览途中停留的各站」，选了经过旧桥的路线。

examples.en: One of the tour stops was a tiny garden behind the main building.
examples.zh: 其中一个「导览停留点」是主楼后面的一座小花园。

words.enDefinition: a count of how many people are present

examples.en: The guide did a head count before our group crossed the main street.
examples.zh: 小组过主街之前，导游「清点了人数」。

examples.en: We waited by the entrance while the trip organizer finished the head count.
examples.zh: 出游组织者完成「人数清点」前，我们在入口旁等着。

words.enDefinition: move fast enough to stay alongside the rest of a group

examples.en: I put my camera away so I could keep up with the group.
examples.zh: 我把相机收了起来，好「跟上队伍」。

examples.en: The guide slowed down so everyone could keep up with the group in the garden.
examples.zh: 导游在花园里走慢了些，让大家都能「跟上队伍」。

collocations: try to keep up with the group
manage to keep up with the group
help someone keep up with the group

words.enDefinition: move more slowly and end up behind the rest of the group

examples.en: It's easy to fall behind the group if you stop to read every sign.
examples.zh: 如果每块牌子都停下来读，很容易「落在队伍后面」。

examples.en: I didn't want to fall behind the group, so I waited to take more photos.
examples.zh: 我不想「落在队伍后面」，就先忍住没继续拍照。

collocations: try not to fall behind the group
start to fall behind the group
easy to fall behind the group

words.enDefinition: meet up with your group again after being apart

examples.en: I went back to rejoin the group after looking at the upstairs display.
examples.zh: 我看完楼上的展区后，就「回到队伍中」了。

examples.en: We could rejoin the group at the town gate after picking up some lunch.
examples.zh: 买完午饭后，我们可以在城门「回到队伍中」。

words.enDefinition: leave the group temporarily to do something on your own

examples.en: You can go off on your own during the break and meet us afterwards.
examples.zh: 休息时你可以「独自离队活动」，之后再来和我们会合。

examples.en: If you go off on your own, we'll see you at the main entrance.
examples.zh: 如果你要「独自离队活动」，我们就在正门碰面。

collocations: choose to go off on your own
time to go off on your own
free to go off on your own

words.enDefinition: time when visitors may look around without following a group schedule

examples.en: The tour gave us free time to explore after the guide finished in the courtyard.
examples.zh: 导游在院子里讲完后，我们有了「自由游览的时间」。

examples.en: We had free time to explore before meeting back at the old market square.
examples.zh: 回到旧市场广场集合前，我们有「自由游览的时间」。

collocations: give visitors free time to explore

words.enDefinition: asks the group to return to this place at a stated time

examples.en: Please meet back here at four so we can all walk to the bridge together.
examples.zh: 「请四点回这里集合」，这样大家能一起走去桥边。

examples.en: Let's meet back here at noon after everyone has seen the upstairs rooms.
examples.zh: 等大家看完楼上的房间，「咱们中午回这里集合」。

collocations: meet back here at the agreed time
please meet back here at three

words.enDefinition: tell the others to begin the trip while you catch up separately

examples.en: Please set off without me if the guide is ready before I get there.
examples.zh: 如果我到之前导游就准备好了，「不用等我，你们先出发」。

examples.en: You can set off without me because I'll join you at the next stop.
examples.zh: 「不用等我，你们先出发」，我会在下一站和你们会合。

collocations: you can set off without me
feel free to set off without me

words.enDefinition: says a tour is behind its planned schedule

examples.en: The tour is running late, so I told my friends to start lunch without me.
examples.zh: 「导览比计划晚了」，我就让朋友不用等我，先吃午饭。

examples.en: The guide said the tour is running late because the previous group took longer.
examples.zh: 导游说上一组用时比较长，所以「导览比计划晚了」。

collocations: the tour is running late today
the guide says the tour is running late
if the tour is running late

words.enDefinition: leave out the final scheduled visit from a tour or trip

examples.en: We agreed to skip the last stop because the group needed to get back earlier.
examples.zh: 小组需要早点回去，所以我们同意「略过最后一站」。

examples.en: Our guide offered to skip the last stop and spend longer by the river.
examples.zh: 导游提出「略过最后一站」，在河边多待一会儿。

collocations: decide to skip the last stop
agree to skip the last stop
have to skip the last stop

words.expression: can we swap the order of the stops
words.lemma: can we swap the order of the stops
words.zhGloss: 我们能调换各站顺序吗
words.enDefinition: asks whether the group can visit stops in a different order
acceptedZhAnswers: 我们能调换各站顺序吗
acceptedEnVariants: can we swap the order of the stops

examples.en: Can we swap the order of the stops so we reach the garden before lunch?
examples.zh: 「我们能调换各站顺序吗」？这样午饭前就能到花园。

examples.en: Can we swap the order of the stops if the market opens later today?
examples.zh: 如果市场今天晚开门，「我们能调换各站顺序吗」？

collocations: can we swap the order of the stops today?
can we swap the order of the stops for tomorrow?
if it helps, can we swap the order of the stops?

words.enDefinition: end a visit earlier than planned

examples.en: We had to cut the visit short because one friend had an evening class.
examples.zh: 有个朋友晚上有课，我们只好「提前结束参观」。

examples.en: I decided to cut the visit short after realizing how late it was getting.
examples.zh: 发现时间已经挺晚了，我就决定「提前结束参观」。

collocations: have to cut the visit short
decide to cut the visit short
need to cut the visit short

words.enDefinition: change an outdoor tour so it takes place inside

examples.en: The guide chose to move the tour indoors when heavy rain reached the village.
examples.zh: 大雨下到村庄时，导游决定「把导览改到室内」。

examples.en: We might move the tour indoors if the garden paths stay wet this afternoon.
examples.zh: 如果下午花园的小路还是湿的，我们可能会「把导览改到室内」。

collocations: decide to move the tour indoors
ask whether to move the tour indoors
have to move the tour indoors

words.zhGloss: 我们能在这儿多待一会儿吗
words.enDefinition: asks for extra time at the current place
acceptedZhAnswers: 我们能在这儿多待一会儿吗

examples.en: Could we spend longer here so everyone gets a chance to see the display?
examples.zh: 「我们能在这儿多待一会儿吗」？让每个人都能看看展出的东西。

examples.en: Could we spend longer here if the next part of the tour is nearby?
examples.zh: 如果导览的下一站就在附近，「我们能在这儿多待一会儿吗」？

collocations: could we spend longer here today?
could we spend longer here before lunch?
if there's time, could we spend longer here?

words.enDefinition: tells visitors that this is the last place on the tour

examples.en: The tour ends here, but you can still look around the garden on your own.
examples.zh: 「导览到这里结束」，大家还可以自己在花园里看看。

examples.en: The tour ends here by the entrance where we met our guide this morning.
examples.zh: 「导览在这个入口结束」，我们今天上午在这里和导游见的面。

collocations: the guide says the tour ends here
the tour ends here by the entrance

words.enDefinition: the smallest number of participants needed for a group activity

examples.en: I checked the minimum group size before signing our society up for the outing.
examples.zh: 给社团报名出游之前，我查了「最低成团人数」。

examples.en: The tour had a minimum group size, so we invited members of another society.
examples.zh: 这场导览有「最低成团人数」要求，所以我们邀请了另一个社团的成员。

words.enDefinition: the language in which a tour is conducted

examples.en: I checked the tour language because two friends wanted to practice their English.
examples.zh: 有两个朋友想练英语，所以我查了「导览使用的语言」。

examples.en: The booking page showed the tour language just above the list of start times.
examples.zh: 预订页面在开始时间列表上方标出了「导览使用的语言」。

words.enDefinition: the final scheduled tour on a particular day

examples.en: We joined the last tour of the day after our visit to the market.
examples.zh: 逛完市场后，我们参加了「当天最后一场导览」。

examples.en: I asked when the last tour of the day would finish at the gardens.
examples.zh: 我问花园里「当天最后一场导览」什么时候结束。

collocations: catch the last tour of the day
miss the last tour of the day
join the last tour of the day

words.enDefinition: asks which group you have been assigned to join

examples.en: Which group am I in for the tour after we split up at the entrance?
examples.zh: 我们在入口分组后，「我分在哪一组」去参加导览？

examples.en: Which group am I in if my name is on the second booking list?
examples.zh: 如果我名字在第二张预订名单上，「我分在哪一组」？

collocations: excuse me, which group am I in?
which group am I in for the walk?
I can't see my name, which group am I in?

words.enDefinition: the largest number of people allowed in a group

examples.en: The guide checked the maximum group size before letting two more friends join us.
examples.zh: 让另外两个朋友加入以前，导游查了「团体人数上限」。

examples.en: We reached the maximum group size, so the organizer divided us into two tours.
examples.zh: 人数到了「团体人数上限」，组织者就把我们分成了两场导览。

words.enDefinition: a book giving visitors information about a place and what to see

examples.en: I borrowed a guidebook to look up the old market before we went.
examples.zh: 我们出发前，我借了本「旅行指南」查查旧市场。

examples.en: The guidebook mentioned a small garden near the river that our map did not show.
examples.zh: 「旅行指南」提到河边有座小花园，我们的地图上却没标。

words.enDefinition: a short printed sheet with useful information for visitors

examples.en: I picked up a visitor leaflet about the house before walking around the garden.
examples.zh: 逛花园之前，我拿了份介绍老宅的「游客宣传折页」。

examples.en: The visitor leaflet showed where the tour would end and where we could sit.
examples.zh: 「游客宣传折页」标明了导览结束的地点，以及我们能坐哪儿。

words.enDefinition: asks which place or feature is worth visiting before the others

examples.en: What should we see first if we only have one afternoon in the city?
examples.zh: 如果在这座城市只有一个下午，「我们应该先看什么」？

examples.en: What should we see first before the upstairs rooms close for the day?
examples.zh: 楼上的房间今天关闭前，「我们应该先看什么」？

collocations: what should we see first in the museum?
if we have an hour, what should we see first?
what should we see first around here?

words.enDefinition: the days on which visitors can enter a place

examples.en: I checked the opening days after deciding to visit the house during our break.
examples.zh: 决定假期去参观老宅后，我查了「开放日期」。

examples.en: The leaflet listed different opening days for the garden and the outdoor market nearby.
examples.zh: 宣传单分别列出了花园和附近露天市场的「开放日期」。

words.enDefinition: allowing visitors to enter on days designated as bank holidays

examples.en: At the UK visitor centre, I asked whether the gardens were open on bank holidays.
examples.zh: 在英国的游客中心，我问花园「公共假日也开放」吗。

examples.en: The leaflet says the tower is open on bank holidays with a different tour schedule.
examples.zh: 宣传单说塔楼在「英国公共假日也开放」，但导览时间不同。

collocations: ask whether it is open on bank holidays

words.zhGloss: 随季节变化的开放时间
words.enDefinition: times when a place opens that differ by season
acceptedZhAnswers: 随季节变化的开放时间

examples.en: The garden has seasonal opening hours, so we looked up the spring schedule first.
examples.zh: 花园的「开放时间随季节变化」，所以我们先查了春季的安排。

examples.en: I noticed the seasonal opening hours when we tried to plan a late visit.
examples.zh: 我们想安排晚一点的参观时，我注意到了「随季节变化的开放时间」。

words.enDefinition: a rule sign forbidding use of camera flash

examples.en: The old house had a no flash photography sign beside the upstairs display.
examples.zh: 老宅楼上的展区旁边有块牌子，写着「禁止使用闪光灯拍照」。

examples.en: I saw no flash photography on the notice before our group entered the room.
examples.zh: 我们小组进房间前，我看见告示上写着「禁止使用闪光灯拍照」。

collocations: a room marked no flash photography
a notice saying no flash photography

words.enDefinition: asks whether visitors may take photographs in this area

examples.en: Are photos allowed here if we turn the flash off during the tour?
examples.zh: 导览期间关掉闪光灯的话，「这里允许拍照吗」？

examples.en: Excuse me, are photos allowed here, or should I put my camera away?
examples.zh: 不好意思，「这里允许拍照吗」？还是我应该把相机收起来？

collocations: excuse me, are photos allowed here?
are photos allowed here during the tour?
before we begin, are photos allowed here?

words.zhGloss: 提供无障碍安排的导览
words.enDefinition: a tour planned to accommodate particular access needs
acceptedZhAnswers: 提供无障碍安排的导览

examples.en: I checked what was included in the accessible tour before sending the link to my group.
examples.zh: 我先查了「提供无障碍安排的导览」包括哪些服务，再把链接发给小组。

examples.en: Our accessible tour included printed notes for visitors who wanted to follow the commentary.
examples.zh: 我们参加的「提供无障碍安排的导览」有印好的讲解资料，方便有需要的游客跟上。

words.enDefinition: a small storage compartment that uses a coin to operate

examples.en: I used a coin-operated locker for my daypack before starting the tour of the house.
examples.zh: 进老宅参加导览前，我用「投币式寄存柜」存了当天背的小包。

examples.en: The visitor center had a coin-operated locker next to the desk where we got maps.
examples.zh: 游客中心在我们拿地图的服务台旁边设了个「投币式寄存柜」。

words.enDefinition: a place set aside for eating meals outdoors

examples.en: We ate lunch in the picnic area before walking back to look around the market.
examples.zh: 我们在「野餐区」吃午饭，再走回去逛市场。

examples.en: The picnic area near the garden entrance had a few tables under the trees.
examples.zh: 花园入口附近的「野餐区」有几张桌子摆在树下。

words.enDefinition: take only a small amount of luggage on a trip

examples.en: I tried to pack light because we would carry our bags all afternoon.
examples.zh: 我们整个下午都要背着包，我就尽量「轻装出行」。

examples.en: We can pack light for this outing and leave the larger bags at home.
examples.zh: 这次出游可以「轻装出行」，大一点的包留在家里。

words.enDefinition: shoes comfortable enough for walking for a long time

examples.en: I wore comfortable walking shoes because we planned to see most of the old town.
examples.zh: 我们计划逛老城的大部分地方，所以我穿了双「适合长时间步行的鞋」。

examples.en: My flatmate brought comfortable walking shoes after seeing how many stops the tour included.
examples.zh: 室友看到导览要停很多站，就带了双「适合长时间步行的鞋」。

collocations: a pair of comfortable walking shoes

words.enDefinition: weather that changes quickly or often

examples.en: The changeable weather made us leave a few hours free for an indoor visit.
examples.zh: 由于「天气多变」，我们留了几小时，可以安排室内参观。

examples.en: I packed an extra layer because the guide warned us about changeable weather near the coast.
examples.zh: 导游提醒我们海边「天气多变」，所以我多带了一层衣服。

words.enDefinition: a small backpack used to carry things for one day

examples.en: I brought a daypack with water and a book for the afternoon trip.
examples.zh: 下午出游时，我带了个「短途用的小背包」，里面放了水和一本书。

examples.en: My daypack fit under the bench while we ate in the garden courtyard.
examples.zh: 我们在花园院子里吃东西时，我带的「短途用的小背包」正好能放在长椅下面。

words.enDefinition: a reduced price offered when people book as a group

examples.en: I asked about a group rate because ten students from our course wanted to go.
examples.zh: 我们课程有十位同学想去，所以我问了「团体票价」。

examples.en: The website listed a group rate for the morning visit our society was planning.
examples.zh: 网站给我们社团计划的上午参观列了「团体票价」。

words.enDefinition: posted messages about arrangements or rules for visitors

examples.en: I checked the visitor notices before choosing which garden path to start on.
examples.zh: 选择从哪条花园小路开始逛前，我看了看「游客告示」。

examples.en: The visitor notices near the gate mentioned a change to the afternoon tour.
examples.zh: 门口附近的「游客告示」提到了下午导览的一项变化。

words.enDefinition: a sign explaining the history or meaning of something visitors see

examples.en: An interpretive sign told us why the old bridge had two different stone arches.
examples.zh: 一块「景点解说牌」告诉我们，为什么旧桥有两个不同的石拱。

examples.en: We stopped by an interpretive sign to learn what the workshop once produced.
examples.zh: 我们在「景点解说牌」旁停下来，了解这间工坊过去生产什么。

collocations: an interpretive sign beside the path

words.enDefinition: asks whether a listed price or ticket covers the tour

examples.en: Does this include the tour of the garden or just access to the house?
examples.zh: 「这包含花园导览吗」，还是只包括进老宅参观？

examples.en: Before I buy the ticket, does this include the tour with the local guide?
examples.zh: 我买门票之前想确认一下，「这包含本地导游带的导览吗」？

collocations: does this include the tour of the house?
does this include the tour as well?
just to check, does this include the tour?

words.enDefinition: a notice saying bookings can only be made online

examples.en: The tour page said 'Online booking only,' so I opened it on my phone.
examples.zh: 导览页面写着「仅限在线预订」，我就在手机上打开了。

examples.en: A sign at the entrance said 'Online booking only' for that morning's garden visits.
examples.zh: 入口处的牌子说，当天上午的花园参观「仅限在线预订」。

collocations: a sign saying online booking only
list a visit as online booking only

words.enDefinition: asks whether admission is possible before the scheduled time

examples.en: Can we enter earlier if a spot opens before our scheduled visit this afternoon?
examples.zh: 如果下午我们预订的参观前有空位，「我们能早点入场吗」？

examples.en: Can we enter earlier because our group has already finished visiting the garden?
examples.zh: 我们小组已经逛完花园了，「能早点入场吗」？

collocations: can we enter earlier if there is space?
can we enter earlier than our booked slot?
since we're here already, can we enter earlier?

words.enDefinition: stand in line while waiting to enter a place

examples.en: We had to queue for entry even though we already had our tickets.
examples.zh: 虽然已经有票，我们还是得「为入场排队」。

examples.en: The guide told us where to queue for entry before handing out the maps.
examples.zh: 发地图前，导游告诉我们在哪儿「为入场排队」。

collocations: queue for entry at the gate

words.enDefinition: arrive too late for the reserved time to enter

examples.en: We might miss our entry slot if we stop for another coffee after lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭后如果再停下来喝一杯咖啡，我们可能会「错过入场时段」。

examples.en: I called the gallery because we were about to miss our entry slot that afternoon.
examples.zh: 我们快要「错过当天下午的入场时段」了，所以我给画廊打了电话。

collocations: try not to miss our entry slot
worried we'll miss our entry slot

words.expression: stop for lunch on the way
words.lemma: stop for lunch on the way
words.enDefinition: pause during a trip to have lunch before continuing
acceptedEnVariants: stop for lunch on the way

examples.en: We decided to stop for lunch on the way to the old mill.
examples.zh: 我们决定去旧磨坊「路上停下来吃午饭」。

examples.en: Do we have time to stop for lunch on the way to the second stop?
examples.zh: 去第二站的「路上，我们有时间停下来吃午饭」吗？

collocations: plan to stop for lunch on the way
decide to stop for lunch on the way
have time to stop for lunch on the way

words.enDefinition: a ticket sales office located at the place being visited

examples.en: The on-site ticket office was just past the sign for the garden entrance.
examples.zh: 「景点现场售票处」就在花园入口的牌子再往前一点。

examples.en: I asked at the on-site ticket office whether a morning slot was available.
examples.zh: 我在「景点现场售票处」问有没有上午的参观时段。

collocations: buy tickets at the on-site ticket office
ask at the on-site ticket office

words.enDefinition: a shop selling small things visitors buy to remember a place

examples.en: We stopped at the souvenir shop after the tour so I could buy a postcard.
examples.zh: 导览结束后我们去了趟「纪念品商店」，我想买张明信片。

examples.en: The souvenir shop had a print of the bridge we had crossed that morning.
examples.zh: 「纪念品商店」有一张版画，画的是我们上午走过的那座桥。

words.expression: what else can we visit nearby
words.lemma: what else can we visit nearby
words.zhGloss: 附近还有什么地方可以参观
words.enDefinition: asks which other attractions are close to the current location
acceptedZhAnswers: 附近还有什么地方可以参观
acceptedEnVariants: what else can we visit nearby

examples.en: What else can we visit nearby before we meet the others for lunch?
examples.zh: 和其他人碰面吃午饭前，「附近还有什么地方可以参观」？

examples.en: What else can we visit nearby now that the courtyard has closed for the afternoon?
examples.zh: 院子下午已经关了，「附近还有什么地方可以参观」？

collocations: what else can we visit nearby today?
after the museum, what else can we visit nearby?
what else can we visit nearby before lunch?

words.expression: can we leave our bags here
words.lemma: can we leave our bags here
words.zhGloss: 我们能把包寄放在这里吗
words.enDefinition: asks whether there is somewhere to store your bags during the visit
acceptedZhAnswers: 我们能把包寄放在这里吗
acceptedEnVariants: can we leave our bags here

examples.en: Can we leave our bags here while we visit the rooms on the upper floor?
examples.zh: 我们上楼参观那些房间时，「能把包寄放在这里吗」？

examples.en: Can we leave our bags here until the walking tour comes back this afternoon?
examples.zh: 「我们能把包寄放在这里吗」？下午步行团回来再取。

collocations: can we leave our bags here during the tour?
excuse me, can we leave our bags here?
before we go in, can we leave our bags here?

words.enDefinition: a notice restricting access to people who have tickets

examples.en: The gate said 'Ticket holders only,' so I waited outside with my friend's bag.
examples.zh: 门上写着「仅限持票者入内」，我就拿着朋友的包在外面等。

examples.en: We saw 'Ticket holders only' next to the shorter queue for the tower visit.
examples.zh: 参观塔楼时，我们看到较短的一条队旁边写着「仅限持票者入内」。

collocations: a sign saying ticket holders only
an entrance marked ticket holders only
a queue for ticket holders only
